## Math

Inline math such as $a_1 * b_2 + \alpha_{i}$ works, as does display math:

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^* = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}, \quad \{x \mid x > 0\}
$$

## Citations

Knuth's book on typesetting [@knuth1984] and Tufte's classic [@tufte2001]
are both cited here.[^1]

[^1]: Footnotes work too.
